sections.credit: A. Local credit assignment and feedback dynamics
sections.temporal: B. Recurrent, online, and delayed credit assignment
sections.continual: D. Selective memory and continual learning
sections.transfer: E. Structural transfer, language, and engineering comparators

papers.title: Random synaptic feedback weights support error backpropagation for deep learning
papers.contribution: Random fixed backward connections can learn useful error alignment.
papers.limitation: Task/model dependent; not a native Full151 gradient or proof of biological circuitry.

papers.title: Direct Feedback Alignment Provides Learning in Deep Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Direct random projections of output errors to hidden layers.
papers.limitation: Requires supervised class targets; compare signal directions rather than assume alignment.

papers.title: Training Neural Networks with Local Error Signals
papers.contribution: Layer-local losses permit deep representation training without layer-to-layer BP.
papers.limitation: Auxiliary supervised heads/labels and local gradient implementations remain necessary.

papers.title: Difference Target Propagation
papers.contribution: Learn approximate inverse mappings to pass targets rather than gradients.
papers.limitation: Backward target networks impose machinery; later scaling studies found limitations.

papers.title: Assessing the Scalability of Biologically-Motivated Deep Learning Algorithms and Architectures
papers.contribution: Negative control: feedback alignment/target propagation can degrade on hard, locally connected visual tasks.
papers.limitation: An important disconfirmation of universal no-BP scaling claims.

papers.title: Dendritic cortical microcircuits approximate the backpropagation algorithm
papers.contribution: Dendritic feedback compartments implement local predictive learning signals.
papers.limitation: Special circuit geometry and error feedback; not observed in native fly compartments.

papers.title: An Approximation of the Error Backpropagation Algorithm in a Predictive Coding Network with Local Hebbian Synaptic Plasticity
papers.contribution: Local prediction-error dynamics approximate deep error propagation.
papers.limitation: Iterative inference and connectivity assumptions must be accounted for.

papers.title: Equilibrium Propagation: Bridging the Gap between Energy-Based Models and Backpropagation
papers.contribution: Contrasting free and weakly clamped equilibria yields principled gradients.
papers.limitation: Requires equilibrating energy-based circuit and often symmetric weights.

papers.title: Scaling Equilibrium Propagation to Deep ConvNets by Drastically Reducing Its Gradient Estimator Bias
papers.contribution: Addresses finite-nudge bias and deep-network scalability of EqProp.
papers.limitation: Deep convnet setting; not evidence for raw recurrent fly sequence learning.

papers.title: Credit Assignment in Neural Networks through Deep Feedback Control
papers.contribution: Feedback controller induces local learning updates related to Gauss-Newton.
papers.limitation: Controller dynamics, output targets and feedback connectivity are required.

papers.title: Augmented Lagrangian Predictive Coding: Training 1000-layer Networks Without Backpropagation
papers.contribution: Augmented-Lagrangian dual feedback extends local predictive-coding credit to deep nets.
papers.limitation: Training very deep narrow MLPs is not sequence/NLP transfer; dual system is additional machinery.

papers.title: Dendritic Localized Learning: Toward Biologically Plausible Algorithm
papers.contribution: Pyramidal/dendritic-inspired local training tested on MLP, CNN and RNN.
papers.limitation: Read the exact feedback pathways and language experiments before claiming entirely biologically local.

papers.title: Credit Assignment via Neural Manifold Noise Correlation
papers.contribution: Low-dimensional neural-manifold perturbations improve credit-estimation efficiency.
papers.limitation: Requires controllable activity perturbations and measured response-manifold geometry.

papers.title: On Biologically Plausible Learning in Continuous Time
papers.contribution: Analyzes temporal overlap between sensory activity, error signals and plasticity.
papers.limitation: Unreviewed preprint; timing claims depend on model assumptions.

papers.title: A Learning Algorithm for Continually Running Fully Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Exact RTRL causal influence benchmark for recurrent learning.
papers.limitation: Gradient computation is computationally expensive and nonlocal.

papers.title: A solution to the learning dilemma for recurrent networks of spiking neurons
papers.contribution: e-prop separates local eligibility traces from approximate neuron-specific learning signals.
papers.limitation: Approximate learning signals, not full exact BPTT; native MiniFly e-prop variants previously failed.

papers.title: Local online learning in recurrent networks with random feedback
papers.contribution: RFLO yields local online RNN updates with random error feedback.
papers.limitation: Sequence-length and approximation limits; published tasks not general NLP.

papers.title: Unbiased Online Recurrent Optimization
papers.contribution: UORO gives an unbiased streaming RTRL estimator.
papers.limitation: Can have large variance; not a biologically local synaptic implementation.

papers.title: Approximating Real-Time Recurrent Learning with Random Kronecker Factors
papers.contribution: KF-RTRL reduces online-gradient variance via structured Jacobian approximation.
papers.limitation: Online differentiable reference, not direct biological plasticity.

papers.title: Practical Real Time Recurrent Learning with a Sparse Approximation to the Jacobian
papers.contribution: SnAp truncates the causal influence matrix by sparse graph reachability.
papers.limitation: Bias depends on recurrence and sparsity; reference rather than native mechanism.

papers.title: Global Credit Assignment via Dynamical Criticality
papers.contribution: COLA uses near-critical temporal correlations for online local credit with O(H) auxiliary state.
papers.limitation: Only appropriate near specified dynamical regimes; requires stability/criticality diagnostics.

papers.title: Unbiasing Truncated Backpropagation Through Time
papers.contribution: ARTBP tests bias from truncation in sequence training, including Penn Treebank.
papers.limitation: Backprop through sampled truncations; a reference not an allowed native method.

papers.title: Decoupled Neural Interfaces using Synthetic Gradients
papers.contribution: Local gradient predictors can decouple module learning and future dependencies.
papers.limitation: Training the gradient predictor may require global-gradient supervision.

papers.title: Eligibility Traces and Plasticity on Behavioral Time Scales: Experimental Support of NeoHebbian Three-Factor Learning Rules
papers.contribution: Biological constraints and time constants for delayed three-factor updates.
papers.limitation: Mostly animal neuroscience; does not derive task-optimal MiniFly gradients.

papers.title: Meta-learning three-factor plasticity rules for structured credit assignment with sparse feedback
papers.contribution: Outer-loop search for local plasticity rules with delayed sparse reward.
papers.limitation: Uses outer-loop gradient/tangent-propagation; cannot be called fully BP-free training.

papers.title: Local plasticity rules can learn deep representations using self-supervised contrastive predictions
papers.contribution: CLAPP learns self-supervised visual/audio/video representations with local predictive Hebbian rules.
papers.limitation: Contrastive data organization and predictive feedback needed; official code uses autograd with blocked gradients.

papers.title: Can local learning match self-supervised backpropagation?
papers.contribution: Derives conditions for local/global SSL update equality in deep linear nets; tests improved local rules in convnets.
papers.limitation: Exact equality is conditional on model assumptions; ImageNet parity not universal.

papers.title: Hebbian Deep Learning Without Feedback
papers.contribution: SoftHebb uses local unsupervised competitive learning without output feedback.
papers.limitation: An external supervised classifier is still used for benchmark evaluation; no native sequence competence.

papers.title: The Forward-Forward Algorithm: Some Preliminary Investigations
papers.contribution: Two forward phases learn local goodness functions without conventional backward passes.
papers.limitation: Requires positive/negative data construction and local negative-sample credit.

papers.title: Self-Contrastive Forward-Forward algorithm
papers.contribution: A more capable local contrastive forward-forward variant on vision/speech benchmarks.
papers.limitation: Layer-local objectives and contrastive assumptions; no demonstrated general NLP transfer.

papers.title: Biologically Plausible Training Mechanisms for Self-Supervised Learning in Deep Networks
papers.contribution: Uses local activity and short-term traces for self-supervised deep representations.
papers.limitation: Engineering comparison, not proof neural circuit naturally discovers syntax.

papers.title: Context selectivity with dynamic availability enables lifelong continual learning
papers.contribution: Gates neuronal plasticity by learned context relevance; NLP continual-learning benchmarks.
papers.limitation: Protect relevant knowledge selectively, not every old fact; typically standard training substrates.

papers.title: Two-factor synaptic consolidation reconciles robustness with pruning and homeostatic scaling
papers.contribution: Normative two-factor synaptic robustness model unifies replay, pruning and homeostatic scaling.
papers.limitation: Focuses recall robustness, not demonstrated compositional inference.

papers.title: Continual Learning Through Synaptic Intelligence
papers.contribution: Task-relevant parameter-importance traces can reduce catastrophic forgetting.
papers.limitation: Important baseline; its importance estimates/optimization are not wholly local native fly.

papers.title: Cascade Models of Synaptically Stored Memories
papers.contribution: Multi-state synaptic metaplasticity improves storage-retention tradeoff.
papers.limitation: Prior MiniFly versions already explored related cascades; not a missing novel mechanism.

papers.title: Why there are complementary learning systems in the hippocampus and neocortex
papers.contribution: Fast episodic vs slow structured integration explains learning/retention trade-offs.
papers.limitation: CLS replay already partly tested in MiniFly; requires meaningful abstraction evidence.

papers.title: Differentiable plasticity: training plastic neural networks with backpropagation
papers.contribution: Outer-loop trains the plasticity rule for rapid online adaptation.
papers.limitation: Outer optimization uses backpropagation: not a pure local-from-scratch result.

papers.title: The Tolman-Eichenbaum Machine: Unifying Space and Relational Memory through Generalization in the Hippocampal Formation
papers.contribution: Separates transferable relational structure from experience-specific content.
papers.limitation: Model uses engineered relational inputs and optimization; cannot be equated with native raw-byte transfer.

papers.title: Generalization without Systematicity: On the Compositional Skills of Sequence-to-Sequence Recurrent Networks
papers.contribution: SCAN demonstrates memorization can coexist with failure of systematic composition.
papers.limitation: Benchmark diagnostic only; not evidence of a biologically plausible learning algorithm.

papers.title: COGS: A Compositional Generalization Challenge Based on Semantic Interpretation
papers.contribution: Natural-language structure recombination split with explicit in-/out-of-distribution metrics.
papers.limitation: Evaluation reference, not request to restart past failed grammar experiments.

papers.title: Linear Transformers Are Secretly Fast Weight Programmers
papers.contribution: Delta-rule fast weight programming and memory capacity links to modern sequence models.
papers.limitation: Outer training uses BP and attention-equivalent operations; comparator, not native candidate.

papers.title: Titans: Learning to Memorize at Test Time
papers.contribution: Trainable persistent neural memory for long-context language.
papers.limitation: Attention + BP dependence; not a demonstrated local biological learning core.

papers.title: Neuromodulated state space models: a dopamine-inspired selective gating framework with memory–stability trade-offs
papers.contribution: Dopamine-inspired input/state/output gates on long sequence benchmarks.
papers.limitation: Motivated state-space architecture trained by standard optimization; not local synaptic credit.

papers.title: Mapping the neuronal building blocks of human language with language models
papers.contribution: Neural recordings illuminate human language representation granularity.
papers.limitation: Observational correspondence, not a local training rule or MiniFly solution.

quality_limits: Source abstracts and identified primary records reviewed; not full-text systematic review
No result replication or paper code execution performed
Paper acceptance status separated from preprints
Not equivalent to MiniFly mechanism availability or biological validation
